value.text: Greptile P1 + cubic P2 findings (PR 215 third-round, unresolved): the missing-package fixture still depended on host metadata — first on a clean shared tmpdir, then on the filesystem root, and a relative TMPDIR made parse(tmpdir()).root empty and could select the checkout's own package.json. Fixed test-first: resolveReleaseContext gains an optional packageSearchBoundary (inclusive stop for the upward package.json search; a non-ancestor boundary fails closed with RangeError instead of silently walking to /), and the missing-package test now builds a fixture it owns (resolved tmpdir, so a relative TMPDIR anchors correctly), plants a decoy package.json directly ABOVE the boundary, and requires the same missing-package error from a path inside the boundary with no package.json anywhere up to it — deterministic on every host, including one where /tmp/package.json or /package.json exists. The red test failed against e20220f (found the decoy, no throw) and passes after the fix. Boundary-inclusive and invalid-boundary regression tests added.
